label: Town of Brookfield
header:
# Town of Brookfield municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 4; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Brookfield official website, Selectboard page: lists John Benson (Chair), Curtis Koren, Keith Sprague, Laura Rochat, and Stuart Edson as Selectboard members.
Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists the Selectboard as J. Keith Sprague III, John Benson, Stuart Edson, C. Curtis Koren, and Laura Rochat.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): publishes no Brookfield roster ('Contact the Town Clerk'); the roster recorded here is from the town's official website.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Carol Monness as Town Clerk of Brookfield.
Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists Town Clerk Carol J. Monness (three-year term, printed end March 2026).
Town of Brookfield, minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual meeting: Carol J. Monness served as Town Clerk at the meeting; the minutes record no Australian ballot results.

Town of Brookfield, Selectboard agenda for March 23, 2026: lists 'Town Auditors and Town Moderator -- Carol and Kristi' (Clerk Carol Monness and Treasurer Kristi Ehlers) as the officers reporting, three weeks after the annual meeting; no official source names any other person as Town Clerk, and she is recorded as holding the office on that post-election evidence.
Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists the Treasurer as 'appt.' -- Kristi Ehlers, appointed by the Selectboard.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kristi Ehlers as Treasurer of Brookfield.
Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists Town Moderator Greg Wight (term ended March 5, 2026).
Town of Brookfield, minutes of the March 3, 2026 annual meeting: note that 2026 was Greg Wight's last year as Moderator; the minutes record no Australian ballot results.

Town of Brookfield, Selectboard agenda for March 23, 2026: lists a Town Moderator 'decline' letter as an item of business. The 2026 outcome and any successor are published in no official source, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists Listers Kristi Ehlers (term to 2028), Tom Garbitelli (term to 2027), and Carol J. Monness (term ended March 5, 2026). Monness's seat stood for election in March 2026 and no official source publishes the outcome; that seat is left unfilled.
Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: prints 'Vacant' for the Auditor office (all three seats). Structure only; the seats are vacant.

Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists Delinquent Tax Collector Kristi Ehlers (term ended March 5, 2026); the town fills the office separately, so the post is created under 17 V.S.A. section 2651d. No official source publishes the outcome of the March 2026 election for the seat, so it is left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists 1st Constable Dan Mason (term ended March 5, 2026). No official source publishes the outcome of the March 2026 election for the seat, so it is left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists 2nd Constable Ed Neas (term ended March 5, 2026). No official source publishes the outcome of the March 2026 election for the seat, so it is left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists five Library Trustees (three-year terms): Emily Noyes (term ended March 7, 2026), Susan O'Brien (term ended March 7, 2026), Amy Borgman (term to 2028), Dan Childs (term to 2027), and Starr Strong (term to 2027). The seats whose terms ended in March 2026 are left unfilled; no official source publishes their outcomes.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: prints the headings 'Agent to Deed Land' and 'Agent to Defend Suits' with no names. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent at annual town meeting.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Brookfield justices of the peace: Elizabeth "Beth" DeForge, Billi Gosh, C. Curtis Koren, Linda Runnion, Perry Kacik, Kym Anderson, and Starr Strong.
Town of Brookfield, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Town of Brookfield Officers 2025' table: lists the same seven justices of the peace, terms ending February 1, 2027.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Brookfield justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
